Cartesius 4 Inch Center to Center Cabinet Pulls

text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-T-06, Cartesius 4" Center to Center Cabinet Pull

Bring the beauty of stainless steel to your kitchen cabinets with the Cartesius Pull. An innovative cabinet pull, it has a seemingly fluid shape that will bring a sense of movement to your space. It has a brushed stainless steel finish. This Acorn made Cartesius 4 Inch Center to Center Cabinet Pull is a perfect example of how modern design doesn't have to focus on function rather than form.

Also Available Matching Cartesius Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Cartesius 4" Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 5-13/16"
  • Height: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
